gaps.lead: There's no milk left in the fridge.
gaps.explanation: run out of = have none left.

gaps.lead: 'I'll call you as soon as I land,' she said.
gaps.sentence: She promised ___ as soon as she landed.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call (me); pronouns shift.

gaps.lead: It's a pity I didn't bring an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + past perfect — I wish I had brought.

gaps.lead: The train takes two hours to get there; the plane takes thirty minutes.
gaps.explanation: twice as fast as = half the time of.

gaps.lead: He was in the habit of jogging every morning.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be in the habit of: was used to jogging.

gaps.lead: I want to go somewhere where nobody knows me.
gaps.sentence: I want to go ___ nobody knows me.
